initial: The first envelope contains data and Boolean hasNext.
patches: Later envelopes carry incremental entries. Each entry has a path rooted at data and exactly one of data or items. data=null replaces that exact subtree by null; object data merges the supplied fields into an existing object. items inserts at the final integer list position; positions are zero based and may equal current length. A nullable list element can therefore become null without removing neighboring indices.
completion: hasNext=false closes the response; GraphQL errors can coexist with usable data. A null patch is applied even with errors. EOF after hasNext=true is incomplete. A frame after terminal is a protocol error when another pump is attempted.
projection: orders contains nullable order objects with unique nonempty id per nonnull order. lines contains nullable line objects with unique id within an order. Invalid duplicate business identities fail the session instead of overwriting. Data shape uses only id,tax,lines,qty. Preserve zero and explicit null; missing tax in preview is null. Completed_with_errors distinguishes final GraphQL errors from protocol failure.
bounds: at most 16 envelopes, 20 orders, 50 lines per order, path depth <=5. A valid path identifies an existing container; additions only at valid list insertion position or absent object field. No arbitrary reordering, reconnect, replay or schema evolution.
sql_publication: One successful frame publishes preview_meta, orders and lines atomically to separate SQLite readers. last_frame counts successfully published data frames. Failed frames preserve the last successful rows and provenance, update status to failed and stop further source consumption. before_commit callback observes the previous snapshot and may raise OSError.
provenance: source_path is a JSON-array string; created_frame records the current source occurrence creation, last_changed_frame changes only when row values or path change, including path shifts caused by list insertion.
